Starts from the sister ch1_census.py (0.9.0_WK_AMGT_HARVST~165) and changes: reads only the served object per partition (the gateway's pick), builds continuation.build(security_key, client) in memory (write_one is never referenced), compares built fields with served fields by parsed value after a JSON round trip, adds the MNST positive and UNH negative controls, the underscore-prefix probe and the non-JSON count. declared_exclusions.item: Any write to S3, any gold or silver writer (continuation.write_one, gold_put, dossier.write_one, --write), any deploy, any edit of a source file, any edit outside <paths>
declared_exclusions.reason: Out of scope by the order. The census wrapper refuses every operation except get, head, list and paginated list. The census calls continuation.build only; it never calls write_one.
The order states the issuer flips its status; this worker did not edit the order file.

surprises: AMGT_HARVST-D1-W168-S1: OBSERVATION -- the gateway lists the underscored prefix research_continuation first (harvest_research.py:46, 76-88); it holds no partition, so every served object was read from the hyphenated partition the census assumed (PROBE-UNDERSCORE-PREFIX partitions=0).

AMGT_HARVST-D1-W168-S2: OBSERVATION -- the gateway builds its continuation prefix from the raw security key (harvest_research.py:343, 438-446), while the partition of a slash key is slash-safe encoded (BP/_LN_Equity -> BP-SLASH-_LN_Equity); the two slash names (BP, NG) are among the 78 and compare fields_changed=0, but which key form callers pass was not measured.
